title: Detailed sailing boat
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Sky glow gradient for Doot's screen -->
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#1a1a3e"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#2d2d6e"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="hullGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#c0392b"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#8e1a0e"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="seaGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#1a5276"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#0e3355"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="sail1" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#fdfdf0"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#e8e0c8"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="sail2" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#f5e6c8"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#dcc89a"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Sea -->
  <rect x="0" y="72" width="100" height="28" fill="url(#seaGrad)"/>
  <!-- Waves -->
  <path d="M0,76 Q6,73 12,76 Q18,79 24,76 Q30,73 36,76 Q42,79 48,76 Q54,73 60,76 Q66,79 72,76 Q78,73 84,76 Q90,79 96,76 L100,75 L100,80 Q94,77 88,80 Q82,83 76,80 Q70,77 64,80 Q58,83 52,80 Q46,77 40,80 Q34,83 28,80 Q22,77 16,80 Q10,83 4,80 L0,79 Z" fill="#2471a3" opacity="0.7"/>
  <path d="M0,83 Q8,80 16,83 Q24,86 32,83 Q40,80 48,83 Q56,86 64,83 Q72,80 80,83 Q88,86 96,83 L100,82 L100,87 Q92,84 84,87 Q76,90 68,87 Q60,84 52,87 Q44,90 36,87 Q28,84 20,87 Q12,90 4,87 L0,86 Z" fill="#1a5276" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Hull -->
  <path d="M14,70 L18,72 L82,72 L86,70 L80,78 L20,78 Z" fill="url(#hullGrad)"/>
  <!-- Hull stripe (lighter edge) -->
  <path d="M17,72 L83,72 L82,74 L18,74 Z" fill="#e74c3c"/>
  <!-- Hull bottom -->
  <path d="M20,78 L80,78 L74,82 L26,82 Z" fill="#7b1a0e"/>

  <!-- Mast -->
  <rect x="48" y="18" width="3" height="52" fill="#d4a054" rx="1"/>
  <!-- Mast lighter edge -->
  <rect x="48" y="18" width="1" height="52" fill="#e8c07a" rx="0.5"/>

  <!-- Main sail (large, right of mast) -->
  <path d="M51,22 L51,68 L82,68 Q78,60 76,50 Q74,40 72,32 Q68,24 60,20 Z" fill="url(#sail1)"/>
  <!-- Sail panel lines -->
  <line x1="51" y1="34" x2="70" y2="34" stroke="#cfc5a8" stroke-width="0.6"/>
  <line x1="51" y1="46" x2="76" y2="46" stroke="#cfc5a8" stroke-width="0.6"/>
  <line x1="51" y1="58" x2="80" y2="58" stroke="#cfc5a8" stroke-width="0.6"/>

  <!-- Jib sail (front, left of mast) -->
  <path d="M47,25 L47,68 L20,68 Q22,62 24,54 Q28,44 32,36 Q38,28 47,25 Z" fill="url(#sail2)"/>
  <!-- Jib panel lines -->
  <line x1="47" y1="38" x2="30" y2="38" stroke="#c4b48c" stroke-width="0.6"/>
  <line x1="47" y1="52" x2="24" y2="52" stroke="#c4b48c" stroke-width="0.6"/>

  <!-- Top sail (small, on top of main) -->
  <path d="M51,10 L51,22 L66,22 Q64,17 61,13 Q57,10 53,10 Z" fill="#f0ebd8"/>
  <line x1="51" y1="16" x2="60" y2="16" stroke="#cfc5a8" stroke-width="0.5"/>

  <!-- Flags -->
  <path d="M50,14 L50,8 L60,10 L50,12" fill="#ff6b6b"/>
  <path d="M49,22 L42,18 L44,22 L42,26 Z" fill="#ffd93d"/>

  <!-- Rigging lines -->
  <line x1="50" y1="20" x2="16" y2="70" stroke="#a08050" stroke-width="0.5"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="20" x2="84" y2="70" stroke="#a08050" stroke-width="0.5"/>
  <line x1="51" y1="32" x2="76" y2="68" stroke="#a08050" stroke-width="0.4" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Sun -->
  <circle cx="80" cy="18" r="8" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="18" r="6" fill="#ffd93d"/>
  <!-- Sun rays -->
  <line x1="80" y1="6" x2="80" y2="3" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="80" y1="30" x2="80" y2="33" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="68" y1="18" x2="65" y2="18" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="92" y1="18" x2="95" y2="18" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="71.5" y1="9.5" x2="69.4" y2="7.4" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="88.5" y1="26.5" x2="90.6" y2="28.6" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="88.5" y1="9.5" x2="90.6" y2="7.4" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="71.5" y1="26.5" x2="69.4" y2="28.6" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Clouds -->
  <path d="M10,16 Q14,10 20,12 Q24,8 30,12 Q34,10 36,14 Q38,18 34,19 L12,19 Q8,19 10,16 Z" fill="#b0c4de" opacity="0.5"/>
  <path d="M58,8 Q61,3 66,5 Q69,2 73,5 Q76,4 77,7 Q78,10 75,10 L60,10 Q57,10 58,8 Z" fill="#b0c4de" opacity="0.4"/>

  <!-- Birds -->
  <path d="M22,28 Q24,25 26,28 Q28,25 30,28" stroke="#c0c0e0" stroke-width="1" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M30,22 Q32,19.5 34,22 Q36,19.5 38,22" stroke="#c0c0e0" stroke-width="0.8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
